model: Densified affine obstruction H_I={0}∪(Q_{>0}×B), B=<u,v,w>, u=(1,0),v=(1,1),w=(1,2)
P_reason: H_I is atomless: every nonzero (q,b)=(q/2,0)+(q/2,b), so 'every irreducible is prime' holds vacuously.
failure_certificate: Projection to B would refine u+w=v+v, but exhaustive bounded search in B finds no witness.
caveat: D/L/R are finite/vacuous for this single obstruction; the model isolates local independence from prime traceability.

model: H=<2,3> with atoms assigned to separate local strata S2={2}, S3={3}
I_reason: Each active local stratum is rank-one free; there is no within-stratum relation.
P_reason: 2 divides 3+3 in the algebraic preorder (6-2=4∈H) but 2 does not divide 3 (3-2=1∉H).
failure_certificate: Complete scalar witness enumeration gives no (e,f,g,h) in H.
caveat: This deliberately separates local independence from cross-stratum prime traceability.

model: Deterministic refinement-obligation machine X→Y→X with no terminal witness state
endpoint_equality: E_D represented by initial obligation X
failure_certificate: The obligation graph contains the directed cycle X→Y→X; no well-founded rank can strictly decrease on every step, and W is unreachable.
caveat: This is an operational countermodel to the recursive TRC mechanism, not an ordinary commutative-monoid counterexample.

model: Prefix refinement system with stages n<ω and witness w_n=1^n; witness universe contains finite strings only
endpoint_equality: E_ω has all finite restrictions solved by the compatible family {w_n}
failure_certificate: All finite witnesses are compatible, but the unique limit witness 1^ω is absent from the witness space.
caveat: This isolates the new transfinite issue: successor/predecessor stages work, but the limit object is missing.

model: Three-patch gluing system; each patch has local witness bit=1, while global witnesses must have even parity
endpoint_equality: E_R restricts locally to P1=1, P2=1, P3=1
failure_certificate: Local witness family (1,1,1) exists and is locally compatible, but violates the global even-parity reconstruction rule.
caveat: This is a finite local-to-global obstruction; limit closure is vacuous.
